name: Pocket Golf 3D
author: Cyberdelia
help: Golf in a rolling 3D landscape. Turn the wheel to aim; the view turns with you. Prev and Next choose the club. Select starts the swing: press it again to set the power, and once more as the marker comes back to the line for a straight shot (early hooks, late slices). Putts take two presses. Play shows the hole from above. Mind the wind, the trees, the bunkers and the water: water and out of bounds cost a stroke. Menu pauses.
